# Narrative Goldmine

> The readable tier of the DreamLab knowledge mesh: a mostly AI-generated
> synthetic corpus, built under human direction, mapping the Fourth Industrial
> Revolution across six domains: artificial intelligence, blockchain, spatial
> computing, robotics, distributed collaboration and infrastructure. It exists to
> exercise and demonstrate the VisionFlow pipeline and VisionClaw engine on a
> medium-scale ontology (~8.1k classes, ~100k relations). It is a testbed, NOT an
> authoritative human-authored encyclopedia. It compiles to a reasoned OWL2 DL
> ontology (Whelk EL++), not a pile of hyperlinks. Every page carries OWL2
> semantics in embedded JSON-LD and a traceable generation record
> (prov:wasAttributedTo did:nostr:jjohare): the record says who directed the
> generation and when, never that a human wrote it.

This site is also an API. Every artifact below is a public, CORS-open,
documented endpoint you may build on as a stable ground-truth dependency. All
counts are generated by the pipeline into /data/graph/stats.json; nothing on the
site is hand-typed.

## Pages (the reading unit)

- [Page JSON](/api/pages/climate-modelling.json): one page as structured JSON:
  id (URN), classIri, domain, definition, subClassOf, typed relationships,
  wikilinks, backlinks. Pattern: /api/pages/<slug>.json
- [Markdown mirror](/api/markdown/Climate%20Modelling.md): the source prose with
  JSON-LD blocks intact. Pattern: /api/markdown/<Title>.md
- [Search index](/api/search-index.json): the full Fuse corpus: id, title,
  labels, definition, domain, iri (urn:ngm:class:<slug>), subclass links.

## Ontology & semantics

- [ontology.ttl](/data/ontology.ttl): the corpus as Turtle: classes, the
  subClassOf backbone and object properties, reasoned under EL++. The TTL
  download is the contract; static hosting excludes a live SPARQL endpoint.
- [JSON-LD context](/ns/): the @context for the ngm: vocabulary.

## Graph tiers (NGG1 binary, so the explorer never loads a monolith)

- [Overview (T0)](/data/graph/overview.json): 6 domain roots + 34 taxonomy
  categories, member counts, pre-baked layout positions.
- [Domain tier (T1)](/data/graph/domain-artificial-intelligence.bin): one
  domain's classes, full subClassOf backbone, object-property edges capped
  per-node top-k. NGG1 little-endian, 24-byte node stride. Pattern:
  /data/graph/domain-<slug>.bin
- [Full graph](/data/graph/full.bin): the whole graph as CSR for power users.
- [Statistics](/data/graph/stats.json): pipeline-derived truth: pages, classes,
  individuals, relations declared/resolvable/shipped, dataset date, pipeline
  version. The only number source on the site.

## Provenance & rights

- Corpus nature: mostly AI-generated synthetic content, produced under human
  direction. A demonstration testbed for the VisionFlow/VisionClaw toolchain, not
  a vetted human reference. Treat claims as generated content with a traceable
  origin.
- Human director / attribution: Dr John O'Hare, DreamLab AI, did:nostr:jjohare.
  The did attests who directed the generation and when. It is not a claim of
  human authorship.
- Source corpus is private (jjohare/logseq); the published projection is open.
- Domains (fixed order 0..5): artificial-intelligence, blockchain,
  spatial-computing, robotics, distributed-collaboration, infrastructure.
